top5.title: Modeling ocular tissues with organoids: A review of techniques and applications in lacrimal gland, cornea, lens, and retina organoid
top5.why: Ocular organoids enable mechanistic study of refractory eye pathologies and tissue reconstruction, advancing translation from basic research to clinical treatment of currently incurable diseases.

top5.title: Low-frequency parasitized cells in bone marrow alter myelopoiesis following immunization with the live attenuated Leishmania major Cen (-/-) vaccine
top5.why: Low-level bone marrow parasitism following Leishmania major Centrin-deficient vaccination enhances myelopoiesis and trained immunity through granulin-Sort3 signaling.

top5.title: Muscular and Tendinous Anatomy of the Feline Crus and Pes
top5.why: Detailed anatomical mapping of feline distal hindlimb muscles reveals sex-related morphometric differences and clarifies the absence of direct anatomical linkage between deep and superficial digital flexor tendons.

top5.title: Effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus immunisation in practice
top5.why: Real-world data confirm RSV vaccines and monoclonal antibodies prevent severe disease in infants and older adults, with maternal vaccination showing cardiovascular benefits, though uptake depends on healthcare integration and provider recommendation rather than product availability alone.

top5.title: Mediator complex: the unsung hero of hematopoiesis
top5.why: Mediator complex dysfunction drives hematopoietic stem cell defects and leukemia pathogenesis, with specific subunits and CDK8/19 kinases as potential therapeutic targets.

also.title: Towards influenza vaccine universality: Smart vaccine regimens and adjuvant-driven germinal center responses
also.why: Adjuvants and antigen design can redirect germinal center responses toward conserved viral regions to overcome strain-specific immunity limitations in universal influenza vaccine development.

also.title: Learning chemical-induced gene expression perturbations with WAVE
also.why: WAVE predicts untested chemical-induced gene expression profiles from compound structures and cell basal states, enabling large-scale transcriptomics-based drug screening without experimental profiling of all combinations.

also.title: The Safety of Melasma Treatment in Vitiligo Patients: An International E-Delphi Study
also.why: Expert consensus prioritizes vitiligo treatment in coexisting vitiligo-melasma, recommends specific topical agents and phototherapy, and identifies hydroquinone as requiring replacement pending mechanistic evidence in vitiligo-prone skin.

also.title: Systemic Loss of Chromosome Y Associates With Age-Related Ophthalmic Diseases in Middle-Aged Men: A Longitudinal Multi-Omic Study
also.why: Mosaic loss of chromosome Y predicts age-related macular degeneration risk through a monocyte-mediated inflammatory pathway detectable years before clinical onset.

also.title: Epigenetic and metabolic plasticity of tumor cells in immunotherapy resistance
also.why: Epigenetic and metabolic plasticity mechanisms drive immunotherapy resistance in solid tumors, with targeting these pathways potentially overcoming acquired resistance.

also.title: Investing in pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response
also.why: Eighty-five feasible pandemic prevention and preparedness actions are identified, with 40 categorized as high-priority investments showing cost-benefit returns exceeding implementation expenses.
